units.name: 아조그(도보)
units.bodyDescription: 오크 표준 뼈대 · 숙인 고개 · 하이앵글 프론트뷰
units.prompt: Rebuild ONE complete production transparent PIXEL game token. INPUT1 original character controls EXACT costume/hair/helmet/beard/palette/weapons, elevated FRONT camera, deeply BOWED hidden face and distinct action silhouette; preserve those identity details. INPUT2 neutral ORC species skeleton controls EXACT FIVE anatomical crown-to-chin heads for crown-to-sole body, ordinary adult skull and shoulder/pelvis/knee/ankle bone lengths, crisp pixel density/stepped dark outlines/short restrained shade ramps. Redress and rotate original neutral bones into INPUT1 action, NEVER lengthen to6–8heads, shrink to4heads or inflate helmet/skull. Slim/muscular/fat changes WIDTH only. Elevated front camera down40–45degrees with crown and both shoulder TOPS obvious, torso/face foreshortened. Head firmly tucked down, eyes covered by hair/helmet/hood/brow; NO frontal facial portrait/eye contact. Retain original body's forward lean or combat action. Do not default to template's walking pose: grounded/braced feet or original lunging as equipment/action warrants, varied lead foot, uncrossed coherent limbs. Complete exact original weapons with logical handgrips; no weapons borrowed from INPUT2. Full silhouette and ALL weapon/banner/antler tips inside INNER80percent canvas. Body center ignores equipment. Transparent background, no base/floor/shadow/scenery/text/watermark/extra figures. Character identity: 아조그(도보) (azog_foot). EXACT original loadout/palette/materials/action from INPUT1. Use ORIGINAL ORC bone proportions exactly; preserve original larger muscle WIDTH for Bolg/Azog and exact claws/prosthetic weapon.

Keep original distinctive body tilt/action while rotating to HIGH-ANGLE FRONT camera DOWN45–50degrees, NOT eye-level frontal portrait, NOT side profile or rear view. Entire exact silhouette including every wing, leg, tail, root, tentacle and weapon tip inside INNER80percent of canvas, generous transparent margins, body independently centered. Transparent background, no base/floor/cast shadow/scenery/text/UI/watermark. Identity: 골룸 (gollum). ONE Gollum only. Preserve original unique emaciated hunched crouching anatomy, bald small bowed skull, huge knuckles and long thin limbs, ragged brown loincloth, both hands forward on invisible ground but no actual floor. High FRONT/down45degrees, crown dominates face, eyes mostly under brow. Do NOT use normal adult human5head/dwarf/chibi bones. Exact original original silhouette.
